entityFieldPolicy: All9 complete canonical records,19aliases (18RELATED_SEARCH,1DEPRECATED_TERM) and empty crosswalk reviewed. Definitions/mechanisms, types/scales, direction, modifiability/volatility, times/lag/persistence, measurements/caveats, observability, evidence, narratives/interactions and null metadata preserved. No blocked fields repaired.
rdsReview: PSY-078 is the only Layer RDS. Required external desired/reference and perceived-current values are not invented Driver constituents. Same-person/goal/window/units/sign and input uncertainty required. Difference recomputation is not causal propagation; signed decrease differs from movement toward zero. Structured rds-review.json records all safeguards.
causalGateReview: REL-PSY-037 is Driver→RDS HEIGHTENED_CAUSAL; all other incident claims STANDARD_CAUSAL. PSY-078 has one incoming and no outgoing causal claim. Four earlier primary reviews reused; no prior pilot proposal altered.

layersConsidered.BIO: Fatigue, sleep loss, stress and physiology considered; GNG/SST outcomes differ from control capacity and endocrine/resource explanation.
layersConsidered.PSY: Planning, monitoring, strategy use and current capacities distinguished from trait, goals, skills, tasks and measures.
layersConsidered.SOC: Work-team training, public reporting and social context; package and cross-study moderator not independent exact social Driver causation.
layersConsidered.CUL: Coping flexibility country/individualism moderator considered; ecological association and construct-invariance uncertainty not causal culture effect.
layersConsidered.ENV: Noise/distraction and setting constraints; prior F06 synthesis reused, exact current control outcome not guaranteed.
layersConsidered.INS: Clinical/institutional programs and schedules alter opportunities, not automatically internal planning or monitoring; no whole external Family review.
layersConsidered.INF: Plan instructions, feedback and progress information require uptake; recommendation specificity not internal plan.
layersConsidered.TEC: Tracking affordance, computer-guided plans and inhibitory tasks considered; visibility/recording/attended monitoring and task improvement separate.

domainsConsidered.DELIBERATE_INTERVENTION: Monitoring prompts, if-then plans, GNG practice and multi-skill therapy/coping packages screened; package outcomes not component efficacy.
domainsConsidered.ROUTINE_UNINTENDED_HUMAN_ACTIVITY: Everyday checking, repeated effort, strategy deployment and lapses considered; between-person association not within-person causal change.
domainsConsidered.EXTERNAL_EVENT_SHOCK: Disruption/stress/exertion changes context; event occurrence not proof of capacity change.
domainsConsidered.ENVIRONMENTAL_EXPOSURE: Noise/distraction and stable action opportunities considered; no exact bounded environmental control effect retained.
domainsConsidered.INSTITUTIONAL_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: Training delivery, schedules/rules and public reporting can change opportunity/accountability; no institutional efficacy from package comparison.
domainsConsidered.TECHNOLOGICAL_CHANGE: Dashboards, web guidance and computer-task training; task interface availability not psychological uptake.
domainsConsidered.SOCIAL_NETWORK_EVENT_PROCESS: Social support/team practice/public report; no social-tie→PSYWERX-edge or network-state target.
domainsConsidered.INFORMATIONAL_EXPOSURE: Prompts, plan cues and feedback may change attention/information; no generic context target or guaranteed belief/commitment.
domainsConsidered.BIOLOGICAL_PHYSIOLOGICAL_PROCESS: Fatigue/sleep-loss literature considered without BIO-F01 changes; no finite self-control resource or pharmacologic recommendation inferred.

propertyPolicy: All11 properties explicitly considered. Two retained effects UNKNOWN/INSUFFICIENT; no dose, threshold, shape or persistence inferred from heterogeneous task meta-effects. STRUCTURE not a direct latent-capacity manipulation or RDS workaround. Nondetection is not supported null.
relationshipPropertyReview: All9incident edges reviewed before PassB. Motivation, fatigue, goal clarity and reporting visibility are possible qualifiers; no exact-edge randomized moderation, relationship-effect or causal pathway established. No B/C overlap summation, no tracking→RDS direct effect.

skepticalReview.method: Separate second pass after draft: inspect primary versus review comparator, go-speed versus inhibition, active versus waitlist, signed RDS and source identity; attempt to falsify exact construct/causal alignment.
checks: PSY-078 two external inputs remain explicit; no inferred denominator, substitute Driver or direct target. Toward-zero example is not a causal model.

Enge active-control null not lost in review's passive-control comparison; immediate/followup and combined/standalone protocols distinct.
Harkin monitoring-frequency benefit does not identify exact generic prompt or signed discrepancy; no mediation from pooled regressions.
ART waitlist gains and common-factor null preserved; 27item past-week profile not instantaneous capacity, no component effect.
Dang small positive versus Vohs confirmatory null not flattened; exploratory result separately identified.
SRC157 PMID mismatch flagged; F08SRC120 issue retained. No canonical repair or duplicated sources/HT0014.
Between-person trait/academic association and country-level coping moderator not within-person causal changes.
skepticalReview.remainingRisks: Exact protocol/measurement alignment and selected-text access limit candidate assertions. No REVIEW_READY effect forced; related capacities and task proxies require future human review.
